A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Human" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''officer''' in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] was the member of a [[Unidentified Imperial officer's family|prominent family]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He used his family's influence to unjustly acquire a promotion to [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] despite his inexperience, so a [[Unidentified Sith Lord (colonel)|Sith Lord's]] attention was directed towards the [[Officer/Legends|officer]], resulting in the officer's failure.<ref name="TOR" />
